name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=render/combat, descriptor=combatant_panels). No address residue. Accurately describes the function: composites the battle backdrop then draws one or two combatant VS panels (portrait + HP bar) and blits the 312x192 region to the mode13h primary surface.
purpose: Battle VS-panel renderer: rebuilds the battle backdrop, draws the first combatant's portrait panel + HP segments + proportional HP bar, optionally draws a second combatant's panel + HP bar, then blits the composed 312x192 region to the mode13h primary surface.
logic_summary: xy_array_ptr points at a 4-int array {x0,y0,x1,y1}. (1) Recomposite backdrop: fd2_composite_battle_tile_map(ws+0x8088, 456, 0xD, 8, origin_x, origin_y) then fd2_composite_all_chars_overlay(). (2) First panel (uses attacker_idx): blit panel sprite 0x30 at (x0-4,y0-4) via fd2_alloc_and_blit_indexed_sprite_chunk; draw the segmented HP bar (width 0x37) at ws+0x808B+(y0+2)*456+x0; draw the proportional HP bar for attacker_idx anchored at &xy[0]. (3) Second panel (only if xy[2] != -1, uses defender_idx): blit panel sprite 0x30 at (x1-4,y1-4); draw the proportional HP bar for defender_idx anchored at &xy[2]. (4) Blit composed frame: fd2_blit_rectangle(0xA0504,320,ws+0x8088,456,312,192). Original tail-calls the shared blit epilogue at 0x11D2C (JMP) which pushes the 0xA0504/320 dest args and calls fd2_blit_rectangle; src emits the explicit full fd2_blit_rectangle call as the functional equivalent.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_render_combat_combatant_panels(uint32 xy_array_ptr, uint32 defender_idx, uint32 attacker_idx)

params.name: xy_array_ptr
params.semantics: Pointer to a 4-int array of panel positions: [0]=panel1_x (attacker), [1]=panel1_y, [2]=panel2_x (defender; -1 = no second panel), [3]=panel2_y. Used both as panel sprite blit coords (x-4,y-4) and as the anchor for fd2_render_combatant_hp_bar_proportional (&xy[0] for panel1, &xy[0]+8 for panel2). Caller passes the speech-bubble/combat-anim descriptor buffer (pCombat_anim_state).
params.reason: Descriptive, accurately names the pointer-to-xy-array role; no address residue; matches FD2 param naming convention.

params.name: defender_idx
params.semantics: runtime_char index whose panel + proportional HP bar are drawn as the SECOND/optional panel (drawn only when xy[2] != -1), anchored at &xy[2]. In the sole caller (retaliation branch) this is the AI caster being hit back.
params.reason: Role label for the second (defender-side) VS panel combatant; no address residue; consistent with body usage and caller context.

params.name: attacker_idx
params.semantics: runtime_char index whose panel + segmented HP bar + proportional HP bar are drawn as the FIRST/unconditional panel, anchored at &xy[0]. In the sole caller (retaliation branch) this is the AI target that is retaliating, i.e. the attacker for that hit.
params.reason: Role label for the first (attacker-side) VS panel combatant; no address residue; consistent with body usage and caller context.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects: composes the VS-panel frame into the render workspace and blits it to the mode13h primary surface at 0xA0504.
